capabilities: Merge and unmerge table cells horizontally and vertically
Resize, auto-fit, and equalize column widths by dragging
Evaluate formulas in cells starting with =
Convert tables between Markdown and HTML format
extras: The manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin notice: "This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff."
problem: Standard Markdown tables in Obsidian cannot express merged cells, header columns, captions, per-column widths, or formulas in cells.
summary: Table enhancement plugin that adds header rows and columns, cell merging, column resizing, captions, formulas, and multiline cells to Markdown tables in preview mode.
